environment: Windows; Java 25.0.2; Docker 29.7.2; isolated PostgreSQL/Redis/Kafka/Elasticsearch Testcontainers
samples: 3 rounds per mode and workload; 600 sequential reads per round; 20 hot keys or 600 cold keys
decision: Keep L1+L2 for high-reuse display reads; keep PostgreSQL as the business fact source; do not claim universal latency or capacity gain
scope: JVM sequential service calls; no HTTP concurrency, resource curve, Redis outage peak or production capacity claim
